operation_details.item: The initial restructuring plan reduced headcount by 15%.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Hey, how's your week shaping up? I saw you had back-to-back strategy meetings yesterday.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yeah, it was a marathon. We finally nailed down the restructuring direction though. The initial plan was pretty aggressive — we were looking at a 15% headcount reduction across the board.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Wow, 15% sounds intense. Is that still the plan, or did it change?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Good thing we pushed back. The current plan is much more measured — we're at a 10% reduction now, and it's all concentrated in back-office roles. Keeps our client-facing teams intact.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That makes sense. So the savings are mostly from streamlining internal ops rather than cutting revenue drivers?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. The tricky part is the severance packages — HR is still reviewing them to make sure we stay competitive but also stay within budget. I want to get that settled before we announce anything.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Makes sense. Keeping it in back-office and getting severance right should help morale too, at least as much as possible.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That's the hope. I know it's never easy, but a softer landing for the folks affected is a priority for me personally.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: It shows. Let me know if you want another set of eyes on the severance numbers before they go to the board.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Thanks, I might take you up on that. I'll grab the latest draft from HR on Monday and we can review it together.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only the initial 15% headcount reduction figure and retain the current 10% plan and its details.
